snippet.title: BATTLE NAP — Official Trailer | Roguelite Twin-Stick Shooter | Coming to Steam 2026
snippet.description:
He just wanted a nap. The dreams had other plans.

Battle Nap is an action-packed roguelite twin-stick shooter where a totally average dad dozes off on a lake floatie and wakes up in a subconscious warzone. Stack wild perks, build a chaotic arsenal, and blast your way through increasingly unhinged dream creatures. The deeper you sleep, the stranger it gets.

Don't wake up. The fight is just getting good.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🎮 PLAY THE DEMO — Steam Next Fest (June 15–22)
➕ WISHLIST NOW (it helps more than you think):
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/4560000/Battle_Nap/
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

ABOUT THE GAME
- Procedural roguelite twin-stick shooter - every run is a different nightmare
- Stack perks, upgrade your stats and choose from 15 different guns
- Bizarre, hand-crafted dream enemies that escalate run by run
- A dad protagonist who absolutely did not sign up for this
- Coming to Steam - Summer 2026

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
